label: Unified Care Model
comment: Complete UCM model including Core, Participation, and Domain semantic layers.

https://w3id.org/dpv#PrivacyNotice.label: Privacy Notice
https://w3id.org/dpv#PrivacyNotice.comment: In UCM: a published statement of an organization's or program's purposes for collecting information and its permitted uses and disclosures, which applies without an individual consent act.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ActivityFocus.label: Activity Focus
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ActivityFocus.comment: The matter, condition, or situation toward which a coordinated activity is orchestrated and which the activity seeks to jointly maintain, update, resolve, or bring about.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ApplicantRefer.label: Applicant Reference Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ApplicantRefer.comment: The role of a person who vouches for an applicant's identity or circumstances, such as homelessness, without acting on the applicant's behalf (NIST SP 800-63A).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#AssuranceCerti.label: Assurance Certification
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#AssuranceCerti.comment: A record that an assessor has found a provider conformant to a trust framework at stated assurance levels, for a period.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Authentication.label: Authentication
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Authentication.comment: A process in which a claimant proves control of one or more authenticators bound to an identity (NIST SP 800-63B).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareCommitment.label: Care Commitment
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareCommitment.comment: A continuing agreement among participants to coordinate care toward a joint purpose, according to terms or conditions that may evolve.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareCoverageGa.label: Care Coverage Gap
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareCoverageGa.comment: A condition in which a care coverage requirement is in force but is not satisfied by any applicable in-force care commitment during a specified interval.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareCoverageRe.label: Care Coverage Requirement
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareCoverageRe.comment: A requirement that some participation in care coordination concerns an activity focus, in a given role, over a defined context or interval.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareTrajectory.label: Care Trajectory Context
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareTrajectory.comment: A position or extent defined relative to the progression of a care process, state trajectory, or coordinated activity, which does not require anchoring to clock or calendar time.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentDirecti.label: Consent Directive
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentDirecti.comment: A record of the choices a person, or a party acting for them, has made to permit or deny identified actions by identified parties, for given purposes, over given information, for a period. Corresponds to an FHIR Consent and an HMIS release of information. It is an information artifact, not a statement.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentGrantor.label: Consent Grantor Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentGrantor.comment: The role of the party who makes a consent choice. Often the same entity as the subject.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentInterac.label: Consent Interaction
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentInterac.comment: A process in which a person, or someone authorized to act for them, grants, refuses, amends, renews, verifies or revokes permission for the collection, use or disclosure of information, or for an action concerning them.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentManager.label: Consent Manager Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentManager.comment: The role of a custodian that maintains the consent record (FHIR Consent.manager).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentPolicy.label: Consent Policy
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentPolicy.comment: A policy, regulation or program rule that sets the consent model, the default decision and the conditions under which consent is required, allowed or not needed.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentProvisi.label: Consent Provision
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentProvisi.comment: A rule within a consent directive that permits or denies specific actions by specific actors, for specific purposes, on specific information, within a period. Provisions nest as exceptions: each provision's decision is the opposite of its parent's.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentProxyRo.label: Consent Proxy Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentProxyRo.comment: The role of a grantor acting for the subject, such as a parent, guardian, legal representative or authorized caregiver.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentSubject.label: Consent Subject Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentSubject.comment: The role of the person or group whose information or care a consent concerns.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentVerifie.label: Consent Verifier Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentVerifie.comment: The role of a party who verified a consent with the subject or grantor.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentWitness.label: Consent Witness Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentWitness.comment: The role of a party who witnessed a consent interaction.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CoordinationRe.label: Care Coordination Request
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CoordinationRe.comment: A process in which coordination is requested between participating entities.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CoordinativeAc.label: Coordinative Care Activity
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CoordinativeAc.comment: A situated activity whose process is shared by participating entities in its care coordination lifecycle.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Credential.label: Credential
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Credential.comment: A set of claims about an identity, issued and signed by an issuer, and held by the subject or a holder, such as a W3C Verifiable Credential.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CredentialServ.label: Credential Service Provider Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CredentialServ.comment: The role of a party that proofs identities and issues or binds authenticators (NIST CSP).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#DataController.label: Data Controller Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#DataController.comment: The role of a custodian that determines the purposes and means of processing and enforces the consent (FHIR Consent.controller; GDPR controller).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#DefinitionArti.label: Definition Artifact
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#DefinitionArti.comment: A ruleset, policy definition, constraint, or governance artifact.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Entity.label: Entity
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Entity.comment: A stable independently identifiable semantic thing.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Handshake.label: Handshake
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Handshake.comment: A coordinative process through which participating entities negotiate mutual participation in a shared activity.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Identifier.label: Identifier
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Identifier.comment: A value, unique within a stated system or issuer, that designates an identity, such as a medical record number, HMIS Personal ID, Medicaid ID, state ID number, OpenID Connect subject or decentralized identifier.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Identity.label: Identity
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Identity.comment: A set of identifiers, attributes and characteristics by which one entity is recognized within a context, such as a system, program, jurisdiction or trust framework. An entity can have many identities.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityApplic.label: Identity Applicant Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityApplic.comment: The role of the entity whose identity is being proofed.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityAssert.label: Identity Assertion
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityAssert.comment: A statement from an identity provider to a relying party about an authenticated identity, at a stated federation assurance level, such as an OpenID Connect ID Token or a SAML assertion (NIST SP 800-63C).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityEviden.label: Identity Evidence
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityEviden.comment: Evidence used in identity proofing: a document, an electronic record, a vouch by another party, or an electronic signature.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityProofi.label: Identity Proofing
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityProofi.comment: A process that establishes, to a stated assurance level, that an identity corresponds to a specific real-life entity (NIST SP 800-63A).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityProvid.label: Identity Provider Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityProvid.comment: The role of a party that authenticates a subscriber and issues identity assertions to relying parties.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#InformationArt.label: Information Artifact
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#InformationArt.comment: A logical information abstraction or computable information object.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#InformationCus.label: Information Custodian Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#InformationCus.comment: The role of a party responsible for holding, managing or enforcing a consent or the data it covers.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#InformationRec.label: Information Recipient Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#InformationRec.comment: The role of a party that a consent provision permits or denies to collect, access, use or disclose information.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#JurisdictionCo.label: Jurisdiction Context
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#JurisdictionCo.comment: A legal or administrative region whose rules govern consent or identity, such as a country, state, county, tribal nation or HUD Continuum of Care. Jurisdictions can nest.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#MatchClaim.label: Match Claim
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#MatchClaim.comment: An assertion that two or more entity references co-refer to the same identifiable entity.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Membership.label: Membership
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Membership.comment: Contextual membership relationship between an Entity and a SocialGroupEntity.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#MembershipCrit.label: Membership Criteria
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#MembershipCrit.comment: Rules or conditions defining membership within a SocialGroupEntity.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Organization.label: Organization
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Organization.comment: Operational or governance-oriented social entity maintaining continuity independent of membership changes.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Participation.label: Participation
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Participation.comment: Contextual involvement of an Entity within a Process and Semantic Context.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Person.label: Person
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Person.comment: A homo sapiens (NCBI) with the social context of a Person.  Looking for an object property of cco:PersonRole to have a "similar to" skos: relationship.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Process.label: Process
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Process.comment: A bounded interaction or activity occurring over time.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ProofingAgentR.label: Proofing Agent Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ProofingAgentR.comment: The role of a person who conducts attended identity proofing for a credential service provider.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#RelyingPartyRo.label: Relying Party Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#RelyingPartyRo.comment: The role of a party that relies on an identity assertion or credential.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Role.label: Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Role.comment: A contextual, anti-rigid classification assumed through participation.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SelfConsentRul.label: Self-Consent Rule
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SelfConsentRul.comment: A rule, in force in a jurisdiction, that sets when a minor or youth may consent for themselves: from what age, for which purposes, categories or sensitivities, and under what conditions.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SemanticContex.label: Semantic Context
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SemanticContex.comment: An interpretive environment, governance scope, or applicability boundary.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SocialGroupEnt.label: Social Group Entity
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SocialGroupEnt.comment: A collective grouping of participating entities.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Statement.label: Statement
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Statement.comment: An informational assertion, finding, determination, or conclusion.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#TrustFramework.label: Trust Framework
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#TrustFramework.comment: A set of rules, under a governing body, for identity proofing, authentication, federation and certification that participants agree to rely on, such as NIST SP 800-63-4, a Kantara assurance program, or the TEFCA Individual Access Services rules.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#TrustedReferee.label: Trusted Referee Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#TrustedReferee.comment: The role of a person authorized by a credential service provider to make risk-based identity decisions for applicants who cannot meet the normal evidence requirements (NIST SP 800-63A).

https://w3id.org/dpv#hasApplicableLaw.label: has applicable law
https://w3id.org/dpv#hasApplicableLaw.comment: In UCM: relates a consent directive or policy to the law or regulation it rests on (FHIR Consent.regulatoryBasis), a concept in ucm:RegulatoryBasis.

https://w3id.org/dpv#hasConsentStatus.label: has consent status
https://w3id.org/dpv#hasConsentStatus.comment: In UCM: relates a consent directive to whether it applies now (FHIR Consent.status), a concept in ucm:ConsentStatus.

https://w3id.org/dpv#hasJurisdiction.label: has jurisdiction
https://w3id.org/dpv#hasJurisdiction.comment: In UCM: relates a consent, consent interaction, policy or identifier to the jurisdiction context where it was given, is in force or was issued.

https://w3id.org/dpv#hasPurpose.label: has purpose
https://w3id.org/dpv#hasPurpose.comment: In UCM: relates a consent provision or privacy notice to a purpose of use it covers, a concept in ucm:PurposeOfUse or SKOS-mapped to one.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#acceptsRequest.label: accepts request
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#acceptsRequest.comment: A participating entity accepts a care coordination request.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#achievedAAL.label: achieved AAL
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#achievedAAL.comment: Relates an authentication to the authenticator assurance level it reached.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#achievedFAL.label: achieved FAL
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#achievedFAL.comment: Relates an identity assertion to the federation assurance level it reached.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#achievedIAL.label: achieved IAL
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#achievedIAL.comment: Relates an identity proofing process or identity to the identity assurance level it reached.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#acknowledgesNo.label: acknowledges notice
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#acknowledgesNo.comment: Relates a consent interaction to a privacy notice the subject or grantor was given or shown.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#assertsIdentit.label: asserts identity
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#assertsIdentit.comment: Relates an identity assertion or credential to the identity it makes claims about.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#authenticatedB.label: authenticated by
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#authenticatedB.comment: Relates a consent interaction to the authentication of the grantor, when consent is given electronically.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#authorizedByCo.label: authorized by consent
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#authorizedByCo.comment: Relates a process, such as a coordination request, handshake or disclosure, to the consent directive that permits it.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#birthDateQuali.label: birth date quality
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#birthDateQuali.comment: Relates a person to how reliable their recorded birth date is.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#certifies.label: certifies
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#certifies.comment: Relates an assurance certification to the provider it certifies.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#consentOnBehal.label: consent on behalf of
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#consentOnBehal.comment: Relates a consent proxy's participation to a person it consents for. Needed when the consent subject is a group, such as a household, and the proxy acts for some of its members.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#consentSubject.label: consent subject
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#consentSubject.comment: Relates a consent directive to the participation of the person or group the consent concerns (FHIR Consent.subject).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversAuthored.label: covers authored by
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversAuthored.comment: The provision covers information authored by the referenced party (FHIR data.meaning authoredby).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversConfiden.label: covers confidentiality
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversConfiden.comment: Relates a provision to a confidentiality level of the information it covers (FHIR Consent.provision.securityLabel with a confidentiality code).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversDataCate.label: covers data category
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversDataCate.comment: Relates a provision to a category of information it covers.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversDependen.label: covers dependents
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversDependen.comment: The provision covers the referenced information and information that depends on it (FHIR data.meaning dependents).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversInformat.label: covers information
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversInformat.comment: Relates a provision to specific information it covers, an information artifact or a statement (FHIR Consent.provision.data).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversInstance.label: covers instance
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversInstance.comment: The provision covers exactly the referenced information (FHIR data.meaning instance).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversRelated.label: covers related
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversRelated.comment: The provision covers the referenced information and information directly related to it (FHIR data.meaning related).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversSensitiv.label: covers sensitivity
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#coversSensitiv.comment: Relates a provision to a sensitivity category of the information it covers (FHIR Consent.provision.securityLabel).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#credentialTerm.label: credential terms of use
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#credentialTerm.comment: Relates a credential to a policy that governs its use (W3C VC termsOfUse).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#dataPeriod.label: data period
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#dataPeriod.comment: Relates a provision to the time span of the data it covers, as distinct from the period the consent applies (FHIR Consent.provision.dataPeriod).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#enactiveDuring.label: enactive during
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#enactiveDuring.comment: Relates a participation to the temporal extent during which that participation is enactive.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#establishesIde.label: establishes identity
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#establishesIde.comment: Relates an identity proofing process to the identity it establishes.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#governedByPoli.label: governed by policy
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#governedByPoli.comment: Relates a consent directive, provision or program to the consent policy it relies on (FHIR Consent.policyBasis).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#governsAction.label: governs action
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#governsAction.comment: Relates a provision to an action it permits or denies, such as collect, access, use or disclose.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasActivityFoc.label: has activity focus
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasActivityFoc.comment: Situates a process within an activity focus.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasCareTraject.label: has care trajectory context
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasCareTraject.comment: Relates a UCM semantic subject to a temporal position or extent defined relative to the internal progression of a process, state trajectory, or coordinated activity rather than directly relative to an external clock or calendar.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasClient.label: has client
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasClient.comment: Convenience projection derived from participation semantics.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasClosureReas.label: has closure reason
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasClosureReas.comment: Relates a closed care coordination request to the reason it was closed.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasCommitmentS.label: has commitment status
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasCommitmentS.comment: Relates a care commitment to whether it is binding on its participants.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasConfidentia.label: has confidentiality level
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasConfidentia.comment: Relates an information artifact or statement to its confidentiality level (HL7 v3 Confidentiality).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasConsentCate.label: has consent category
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasConsentCate.comment: Relates a consent directive to its kind, such as a privacy consent or release of information, a treatment consent or a research consent.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasConsentDeci.label: has consent decision
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasConsentDeci.comment: Relates a consent directive or provision to its permit or deny decision. Every provision states its own decision, the opposite of its parent's.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasConsentInte.label: has consent interaction type
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasConsentInte.comment: Relates a consent interaction to what it did: grant, refuse, amend, renew, revoke or verify.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasConsentModa.label: has consent modality
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasConsentModa.comment: Relates a consent interaction to how consent was expressed: written, electronic, verbal or inferred.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasConsentMode.label: has consent model
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasConsentMode.comment: Relates a policy, program or notice to its consent model, such as opt-in or opt-out.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasEvidenceStr.label: has evidence strength
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasEvidenceStr.comment: Relates identity evidence to its NIST strength: fair, strong or superior.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasEvidenceTyp.label: has evidence type
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasEvidenceTyp.comment: Relates identity evidence to its kind: document, electronic record, vouch or electronic signature.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasHandoffStat.label: has handoff status
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasHandoffStat.comment: Relates a handshake to where responsibility for its agreed services stands between the sending and receiving parties.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasHandshakeFu.label: has handshake fulfillment
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasHandshakeFu.comment: Relates a handshake to how much of its negotiated service has been delivered.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasIdentifier.label: has identifier
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasIdentifier.comment: Relates an identity to an identifier that designates it.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasIdentifierT.label: has identifier type
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasIdentifierT.comment: Relates an identifier to its kind, such as a medical record number or HMIS Personal ID.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasIdentity.label: has identity
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasIdentity.comment: Relates any entity to an identity by which it is recognized. An entity can have many identities.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasLifecycleSt.label: has lifecycle state
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasLifecycleSt.comment: Relates a process to a lifecycle state.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasPatient.label: has patient
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasPatient.comment: Convenience projection derived from participation semantics.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasProofingTyp.label: has proofing type
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasProofingTyp.comment: Relates an identity proofing process to how it was conducted: remote or on-site, attended or unattended.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasProvision.label: has provision
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasProvision.comment: Relates a consent directive, or an enclosing provision, to a provision within it (FHIR Consent.provision).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasReferralDis.label: has referral disposition
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasReferralDis.comment: Relates a care coordination request to the receiving party's decision on it.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasResident.label: has resident
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasResident.comment: Convenience projection derived from participation semantics.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasRetentionDi.label: has retention disposition
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasRetentionDi.comment: Relates a consent directive or provision to what happens to the data when its retention period ends.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasSensitivity.label: has sensitivity label
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasSensitivity.comment: Relates an information artifact or statement to a sensitivity category, so provisions can match data without listing records (FHIR meta.security).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasTemporalCon.label: has temporal context
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasTemporalCon.comment: Relates a UCM semantic subject to a temporal entity that qualifies when that subject occurs, obtains, applies, participates, or is otherwise temporally situated.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#identifiedAs.label: identified as
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#identifiedAs.comment: Relates a participation to the identity under which the participant acted. This ties a consent's grantor and subject to identities.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#identityOf.label: identity of
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#identityOf.comment: Relates an identity to the entity it identifies.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#issuedBy.label: issued by
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#issuedBy.comment: Relates an identifier, credential or certification to the entity that issued it.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#matchesIdentit.label: matches identity
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#matchesIdentit.comment: Relates a match claim to an identity it says co-refers with the others it names.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#negotiates.label: negotiates
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#negotiates.comment: Relates a handshake to the care coordination process whose participation relationship it negotiates.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#occursDuring.label: occurs during
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#occursDuring.comment: Relates a process to the temporal extent during which the process occurs.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#postedAt.label: posted at
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#postedAt.comment: Relates a privacy notice to a location where it is posted, such as an intake desk.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#processingLoca.label: processing location
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#processingLoca.comment: Relates a consent directive or provision to a jurisdiction where the data may be stored or processed. Several values mean any of them is allowed (ISO/IEC TS 27560 storage and processing locations).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#provisionActor.label: provision actor
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#provisionActor.comment: Relates a provision to the participation of a party it permits or denies (FHIR Consent.provision.actor).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#recordsConsent.label: records consent from
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#recordsConsent.comment: Relates a consent directive to the consent interaction that produced, amended or revoked it.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#requiresAAL.label: requires AAL
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#requiresAAL.comment: Relates a consent policy or trust framework to the minimum authenticator assurance level it requires.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#requiresIAL.label: requires IAL
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#requiresIAL.comment: Relates a consent policy or trust framework to the minimum identity assurance level it requires.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#revokedBy.label: revoked by
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#revokedBy.comment: Relates a consent directive to the consent interaction that revoked it.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#selfConsentCon.label: self-consent condition
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#selfConsentCon.comment: Relates a self-consent rule to a condition that unlocks self-consent. Several values mean any one suffices.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#selfConsentSco.label: self-consent scope
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#selfConsentSco.comment: Relates a self-consent rule to a purpose, consent category, information category or sensitivity it covers. No value means all consents.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#sourceDocument.label: source document
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#sourceDocument.comment: Relates a consent directive or privacy notice to its source, such as a scanned signed form or the policy text.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#statementSubje.label: statement subject
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#statementSubje.comment: Relates a statement to the contextual participation it is about.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#supersedes.label: supersedes
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#supersedes.comment: Relates a consent directive to an earlier directive it amends or renews.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#underTrustFram.label: under trust framework
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#underTrustFram.comment: Relates an identity proofing, assertion, credential or certification to the trust framework whose rules it follows.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#usedEvidence.label: used evidence
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#usedEvidence.comment: Relates an identity proofing process to evidence it used.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#validDuring.label: valid during
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#validDuring.comment: Relates a semantic subject or statement to the temporal extent during which its described condition, state, relationship, participation, or other semantics apply.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#withinJurisdic.label: within jurisdiction
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#withinJurisdic.comment: Relates a jurisdiction to a larger jurisdiction that contains it, such as a county within a state or a Continuum of Care within a state.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#amendmentAppli.label: amendment applies retroactively
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#amendmentAppli.comment: Whether an amendment to the privacy notice applies to information collected before the amendment.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#assuranceRank.label: assurance rank
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#assuranceRank.comment: An integer rank on an assurance or strength level, so levels in one scheme can be compared with >=.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#birthDate.label: birth date
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#birthDate.comment: A person's date of birth, full (xsd:date) or partial (xsd:gYearMonth or xsd:gYear). Age is computed as of a given date and never stored.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#identifierSyst.label: identifier system
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#identifierSyst.comment: The namespace in which an identifier value is unique. For an OpenID Connect subject, the issuer.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#minimumSelfCon.label: minimum self-consent age
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#minimumSelfCon.comment: The age in years from which a self-consent rule allows self-consent. Omitted when only a condition applies.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#recordLocked.label: record locked
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#recordLocked.comment: Convenience flag that the subject's record is locked to other agencies. Prefer a sensitivity label plus a deny provision.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#retentionPerio.label: retention period
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#retentionPerio.comment: How long data covered by the consent may be kept, as a duration such as P7Y (ISO/IEC TS 27560 retention period).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#trustFramework.label: trust framework identifier
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#trustFramework.comment: The string that names a trust framework in identity claims, such as the OpenID Connect for Identity Assurance trust_framework value.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#withdrawalMeth.label: withdrawal method
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#withdrawalMeth.comment: How the person can revoke the consent: a URL, phone number, form or written instructions, as text (ISO/IEC TS 27560 withdrawal method).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#AuthenticatorA.label: Authenticator Assurance Level
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#AuthenticatorA.description: How strongly was the claimant authenticated?

concepts.label: AAL1
concepts.definition: Basic confidence that the claimant controls an authenticator bound to the subscriber account, using single-factor or multi-factor authentication (NIST AAL1).

concepts.label: AAL2
concepts.definition: High confidence from proof of possession and control of two distinct authentication factors. Verifiers must offer at least one phishing-resistant option (NIST AAL2).

concepts.label: AAL3
concepts.definition: Very high confidence from a phishing-resistant cryptographic authenticator with a non-exportable private key; syncable authenticators are not allowed (NIST AAL3).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#BirthDateQuali.label: Birth Date Quality
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#BirthDateQuali.description: How reliable is the recorded birth date?

concepts.label: Approximate or partial
concepts.definition: An approximate or partial date of birth was reported (HMIS: Approximate or partial DOB reported).

concepts.label: Client doesn't know
concepts.definition: The person does not know their date of birth. HMIS allows this only with no birth date recorded.

concepts.label: Client prefers not to answer
concepts.definition: The person declined to give their date of birth. HMIS allows this only with no birth date recorded.

concepts.label: Data not collected
concepts.definition: The date of birth was not collected. HMIS allows this only with no birth date recorded.

concepts.label: Full date reported
concepts.definition: The full date of birth was reported (HMIS: Full DOB reported).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ClosureReason.label: Closure Reason
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ClosureReason.description: Why did the care coordination episode end?

concepts.label: Declined by the person
concepts.definition: The person chose not to receive the requested services.

concepts.label: Person unreachable
concepts.definition: The receiving party could not reach the person.

concepts.label: Connected
concepts.definition: The person was connected to the requested services.

concepts.label: No longer needed
concepts.definition: The need was resolved, or stopped applying, without the requested services.

concepts.label: Not connected
concepts.definition: The episode ended without connecting the person to the requested services. Record a narrower concept when the reason is known.

concepts.label: Ineligible
concepts.definition: The person does not meet the receiving program's eligibility criteria.

concepts.label: Missing verification
concepts.definition: Documentation or verification the receiving party requires was not provided.

concepts.label: Other reason
concepts.definition: Not connected for a reason not listed here.

concepts.label: Out of area
concepts.definition: The person is outside the receiving party's service area.

concepts.label: Program at capacity
concepts.definition: The receiving program had no capacity for the person.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CommitmentStat.label: Commitment Status
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CommitmentStat.description: Is a care commitment binding on its participants?

concepts.label: In force
concepts.definition: The commitment is agreed and binding on its participants.

concepts.label: Lapsed
concepts.definition: The commitment ended without being released, for example by expiry or abandonment.

concepts.label: Proposed
concepts.definition: The commitment has been offered but not yet agreed.

concepts.label: Released
concepts.definition: The commitment ended deliberately: completed, handed over or ended by agreement.

concepts.label: Suspended
concepts.definition: The commitment is agreed but temporarily not binding.

concepts.label: Low
concepts.definition: Low confidentiality; minimal harm if disclosed.

concepts.label: Moderate
concepts.definition: Moderate confidentiality.

concepts.label: Normal
concepts.definition: The usual level for health and social care information.

concepts.label: Restricted
concepts.definition: Highly sensitive; restricted to a few parties.

concepts.label: Unrestricted
concepts.definition: Not confidential; may be shared freely.

concepts.label: Very restricted
concepts.definition: Extremely sensitive; very few parties may see it.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentAction.label: Consent Action
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentAction.description: What action does this provision permit or deny?

concepts.label: Access
concepts.definition: to access data

concepts.label: Collect
concepts.definition: to gather data from someone

concepts.label: Access and correct
concepts.definition: Access information in order to correct it.

concepts.label: Disclose
concepts.definition: to make data known

concepts.label: Redisclose
concepts.definition: A recipient releasing information it received to a further party.

concepts.label: Use
concepts.definition: to use data

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentCategor.label: Consent Category
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentCategor.description: What kind of consent is this?

concepts.label: Advance directive
concepts.definition: Instructions for future care if the person cannot decide for themselves. Placeholder.

concepts.label: Consent to collect
concepts.definition: Consent for an organization to collect and record a person's information.

concepts.label: Consent to share
concepts.definition: Consent for information already held to be shared with other parties.

concepts.label: Privacy consent
concepts.definition: Consent concerning the collection, use or disclosure of information.

concepts.label: Release of information
concepts.definition: Consent to release or share a person's information with named parties, such as an HMIS ROI.

concepts.label: Research consent
concepts.definition: Consent to take part in research or for information to be used in research.

concepts.label: Treatment consent
concepts.definition: Consent to receive a treatment, procedure or service.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentDecisio.label: Consent Decision
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentDecisio.description: Does this consent or provision permit or deny?

concepts.label: Deny
concepts.definition: The actions in scope are denied.

concepts.label: Permit
concepts.definition: The actions in scope are permitted.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentInterac.label: Consent Interaction Type
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentInterac.description: What did this consent interaction do?

concepts.label: Amend
concepts.definition: An existing consent was changed.

concepts.label: Grant
concepts.definition: Consent was given.

concepts.label: Refuse
concepts.definition: Consent was declined.

concepts.label: Renew
concepts.definition: An existing consent was confirmed for a further period.

concepts.label: Revoke
concepts.definition: An existing consent was withdrawn.

concepts.label: Verify
concepts.definition: An existing consent was verified with the subject or grantor, or a self-consent condition was verified by a third party.

concepts.label: Electronic
concepts.definition: Written consent given through an electronic signature or form.

concepts.label: Inferred
concepts.definition: Consent inferred from a posted notice and the person's continued participation.

concepts.label: Verbal
concepts.definition: Consent given orally and recorded by staff.

concepts.label: Written
concepts.definition: Consent given in writing, on paper or electronically.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentModel.label: Consent Model
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ConsentModel.description: What is the default when no individual choice is recorded?

concepts.label: No consent required
concepts.definition: Another lawful basis applies, so individual consent is not needed.

concepts.label: Opt-in
concepts.definition: Information is not shared unless the person consents.

concepts.label: Opt-in with restrictions
concepts.definition: The person may opt in and restrict what is shared.

concepts.label: Opt-out
concepts.definition: Information is shared unless the person objects.

concepts.label: Opt-out with exceptions
concepts.definition: Information is shared unless the person objects, and some information always needs explicit consent.

concepts.label: Active
concepts.definition: The directive is in force.

concepts.label: Draft
concepts.definition: The directive is being prepared and is not yet in force.

concepts.label: Entered in error
concepts.definition: The directive was recorded by mistake and should be disregarded.

concepts.label: Consent Expired
concepts.definition: The state where the temporal or contextual validity of consent has 'expired'

concepts.label: Inactive
concepts.definition: The directive was in force and no longer is. Record a narrower reason when known.

concepts.label: Consent Refused
concepts.definition: The state where consent has been refused

concepts.label: Consent Revoked
concepts.definition: The state where the consent is revoked by an entity other than the data subject and which prevents it from being further used as a valid state

concepts.label: Superseded
concepts.definition: A newer directive amended or renewed this one.

concepts.label: Consent Unknown
concepts.definition: State where information about consent is not available or is unknown

concepts.label: Consent Withdrawn
concepts.definition: The state where the consent is withdrawn or revoked specifically by the data subject and which prevents it from being further used as a valid state

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#EvidenceStreng.label: Evidence Strength
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#EvidenceStreng.description: How strong is this identity evidence?

concepts.label: Fair
concepts.definition: Evidence of fair strength (NIST FAIR).

concepts.label: Strong
concepts.definition: Evidence of strong strength (NIST STRONG).

concepts.label: Superior
concepts.definition: Evidence of superior strength (NIST SUPERIOR).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#FederationAssu.label: Federation Assurance Level
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#FederationAssu.description: How strongly was the identity assertion protected?

concepts.label: FAL1
concepts.definition: Basic protection: the identity provider signs the assertion with approved cryptography and restricts its audience to a specific relying party or set of relying parties (NIST FAL1).

concepts.label: FAL2
concepts.definition: High protection: the assertion is strongly protected from injection attacks and audience-restricted to a single relying party, under a pre-established trust agreement (NIST FAL2).

concepts.label: FAL3
concepts.definition: Very high protection: the relying party also verifies that the subscriber controls an authenticator, named in a holder-of-key assertion or bound to the account, which guards against a compromised identity provider (NIST FAL3).

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#HandoffStatus.label: Handoff Status
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#HandoffStatus.description: Where does responsibility for the agreed services stand between the sending and receiving parties?

concepts.label: Acknowledged
concepts.definition: The receiving party has acknowledged the handoff but has not yet assumed responsibility.

concepts.label: Assumed
concepts.definition: The receiving party has assumed responsibility for the agreed services, and the sending party has released it.

concepts.label: Dropped
concepts.definition: The sending party released responsibility before the receiving party assumed it, leaving no one responsible for the agreed services.

concepts.label: Offered
concepts.definition: The sending party has offered responsibility for the agreed services; the receiving party has not acknowledged it.

concepts.label: Returned
concepts.definition: The receiving party handed responsibility back to the sending party.

concepts.label: Shared
concepts.definition: The sending and receiving parties hold responsibility for the agreed services jointly.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#HandshakeFulfi.label: Handshake Fulfillment
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#HandshakeFulfi.description: How much of the service negotiated in a handshake has been delivered?

concepts.label: Confirmed delivered
concepts.definition: The requesting party has confirmed that the negotiated services were delivered.

concepts.label: Not started
concepts.definition: None of the negotiated services has been delivered yet.

concepts.label: Partially delivered
concepts.definition: Some, but not all, of the negotiated services have been delivered.

concepts.label: Reported delivered
concepts.definition: The delivering party reports the negotiated services delivered; the requesting party has not confirmed it.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentifierType.label: Identifier Type
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentifierType.description: What kind of identifier is this?

concepts.label: Decentralized identifier
concepts.definition: A W3C decentralized identifier (DID).

concepts.label: Driver's license number
concepts.definition: A driver's license number.

concepts.label: HMIS Personal ID
concepts.definition: The HMIS Personal ID.

concepts.label: Medicaid ID
concepts.definition: A Medicaid member identifier.

concepts.label: Medical record number
concepts.definition: An identifier assigned by a health care organization.

concepts.label: OpenID Connect subject
concepts.definition: An OpenID Connect sub value, unique within its issuer.

concepts.label: Other identifier
concepts.definition: Another kind of identifier.

concepts.label: Social Security number
concepts.definition: A U.S. Social Security number.

concepts.label: State ID number
concepts.definition: A state-issued identification card number.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityAssura.label: Identity Assurance Level
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityAssura.description: How strongly was this identity proofed?

concepts.label: IAL1
concepts.definition: Identity proofing that confirms the claimed identity exists and is likely the applicant's (NIST IAL1).

concepts.label: IAL2
concepts.definition: Identity proofing with stronger evidence and verification, remote or in person (NIST IAL2).

concepts.label: IAL3
concepts.definition: Identity proofing in person or supervised remote, with the strongest evidence (NIST IAL3).

concepts.label: No identity proofing
concepts.definition: No identity proofing was performed; attributes are self-asserted.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityEviden.label: Identity Evidence Type
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#IdentityEviden.description: What kind of identity evidence is this?

concepts.label: Document
concepts.definition: A physical or digital identity document.

concepts.label: Electronic record
concepts.definition: An electronic record from an authoritative source.

concepts.label: Electronic signature
concepts.definition: An electronic signature tied to a verified identity.

concepts.label: Vouch
concepts.definition: An attestation by another party, such as an applicant reference.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#InformationCat.label: Information Category
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#InformationCat.description: What kind of information is covered?

concepts.label: Behavioral health information
concepts.definition: Mental health and substance use information.

concepts.label: Child welfare information
concepts.definition: Child welfare and family services information.

concepts.label: Clinical information
concepts.definition: Health and clinical care information.

concepts.label: Education
concepts.definition: Information about education

concepts.label: Housing information
concepts.definition: Housing status, history, assessments and placements.

concepts.label: Identifying
concepts.definition: Information that uniquely or semi-uniquely identifies an individual or a group

concepts.label: Income and benefits information
concepts.definition: Income, employment and public benefits information.

concepts.label: Justice information
concepts.definition: Criminal and juvenile justice information.

concepts.label: Nutrition information
concepts.definition: Food security and nutrition information.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#LifecycleState.label: Lifecycle State
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#LifecycleState.description: A state associated with a process during a portion of its lifecycle.

concepts.label: Accepted Care Coordination Lifecycle
concepts.definition: A care coordination request that has been accepted for ongoing care.

concepts.label: Declined Care Coordination Lifecycle
concepts.definition: This care request was denied.

concepts.label: Pending Care Coordination Lifecycle
concepts.definition: A pending care coordination request.

concepts.label: On-site attended
concepts.definition: On-site proofing with a proofing agent present.

concepts.label: On-site unattended
concepts.definition: On-site proofing at a kiosk or device with no agent.

concepts.label: Remote attended
concepts.definition: Remote proofing with a proofing agent over video.

concepts.label: Remote unattended
concepts.definition: Remote proofing with no proofing agent present.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#PurposeOfUse.label: Purpose of Use
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#PurposeOfUse.description: For what purpose may the information be used?

concepts.label: Benefits enrollment
concepts.definition: Applying for, enrolling in or recertifying public benefits.

concepts.label: Care coordination
concepts.definition: Coordinating care for the person across providers.

concepts.label: Care management
concepts.definition: Managing a person's care over time.

concepts.label: Coordinated entry
concepts.definition: Assessing, prioritizing and referring people experiencing homelessness through a Continuum of Care's coordinated entry process.

concepts.label: Eligibility determination
concepts.definition: Determining whether the person is eligible for a program or benefit.

concepts.label: Emergency treatment
concepts.definition: Providing care in an emergency.

concepts.label: Family requested
concepts.definition: Disclosure requested by the person's family.

concepts.label: Operations
concepts.definition: Operating the organization that provides care or services.

concepts.label: Housing placement
concepts.definition: Matching a person or household to a housing program or unit and moving them in.

concepts.label: Person requested
concepts.definition: Disclosure requested by the person themselves.

concepts.label: Payment
concepts.definition: Payment for care or services.

concepts.label: Program reporting
concepts.definition: Required reporting to funders or oversight bodies, such as HUD HMIS reports.

concepts.label: Public health
concepts.definition: Public health activities and reporting.

concepts.label: Scientific Research
concepts.definition: Purposes associated with scientific research

concepts.label: Social care coordination
concepts.definition: Coordinating social care services for a person or household across agencies and programs.

concepts.label: Social case management
concepts.definition: Ongoing case management by a social care provider.

concepts.label: Social services referral
concepts.definition: Referring a person to a community-based or government service and tracking whether they were connected.

concepts.label: Treatment
concepts.definition: Providing health care or services to the person.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ReferralDispos.label: Referral Disposition
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ReferralDispos.description: What has the receiving party decided about a care coordination request?

concepts.label: Accepted
concepts.definition: The receiving party agreed to take part in the requested coordination.

concepts.label: Declined
concepts.definition: The receiving party declined the request. The reason is recorded with a ucm:ClosureReason concept.

concepts.label: Expired
concepts.definition: The receiving party made no decision within the time allowed for a response.

concepts.label: Pending
concepts.definition: The request has been sent and the receiving party has not yet decided.

concepts.label: Withdrawn
concepts.definition: The requesting party withdrew the request before the receiving party decided.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#RegulatoryBasi.label: Regulatory Basis
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#RegulatoryBasi.description: Which law or regulation does this consent rest on?

concepts.label: 42 CFR Part 2
concepts.definition: Confidentiality of Substance Use Disorder Patient Records, 42 CFR Part 2.

concepts.label: Common Rule
concepts.definition: The Federal Policy for the Protection of Human Subjects (45 CFR 46).

concepts.label: FERPA
concepts.definition: The Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (20 U.S.C. 1232g; 34 CFR Part 99).

concepts.label: HIPAA
concepts.definition: The HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Parts 160 and 164).

concepts.label: HIPAA authorization
concepts.definition: A HIPAA authorization for a use or disclosure.

concepts.label: HIPAA notice of privacy practices
concepts.definition: A HIPAA notice of privacy practices.

concepts.label: HIPAA research
concepts.definition: A HIPAA authorization for research.

concepts.label: HMIS Data Standards
concepts.definition: The HUD HMIS Data and Technical Standards, including the privacy and security standards, and the current HMIS Data Standards.

concepts.label: State law
concepts.definition: A state, territorial or tribal law.

concepts.label: VAWA
concepts.definition: The Violence Against Women Act confidentiality provisions, which bar victim service providers from entering personally identifying information into HMIS.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#RetentionDispo.label: Retention Disposition
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#RetentionDispo.description: What happens to the data when its retention period ends?

concepts.label: Archive
concepts.definition: The information is archived with restricted access.

concepts.label: De-identify
concepts.definition: The information is de-identified and may be kept.

concepts.label: Delete
concepts.definition: The information is deleted.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SelfConsentCon.label: Self-Consent Condition
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SelfConsentCon.description: What condition lets a minor or youth consent for themselves?

concepts.label: Age of majority
concepts.definition: The person has reached the age of majority in the jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Emancipated minor
concepts.definition: The person is a legally emancipated minor.

concepts.label: Married minor
concepts.definition: The person is a married minor.

concepts.label: Mature minor
concepts.definition: A clinician judged the minor to have capacity to consent.

concepts.label: Minor parent
concepts.definition: The person is a minor who is a parent.

concepts.label: Postsecondary enrollment
concepts.definition: The person attends a postsecondary institution.

concepts.label: Self-supporting
concepts.definition: The person supports themselves financially.

concepts.label: Service-specific minor consent
concepts.definition: The law lets minors consent to this particular service, such as STI or substance use treatment.

concepts.label: Unaccompanied youth
concepts.definition: The person is a youth living without a parent or guardian, such as an unaccompanied homeless youth.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SensitivityCat.label: Sensitivity Category
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SensitivityCat.description: What sensitive topic does the information concern?

concepts.label: Abortion
concepts.definition: Information about seeking, obtaining, providing or facilitating abortion. Kept separate because its legal sensitivity varies by jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Adolescent
concepts.definition: Information about an adolescent's care that calls for extra protection.

concepts.label: Alcohol use disorder
concepts.definition: Information about an alcohol use disorder.

concepts.label: Behavioral health
concepts.definition: Information about behavioral health.

concepts.label: Gender and sexual orientation
concepts.definition: Information about gender identity or sexual orientation.

concepts.label: Genetic disease
concepts.definition: Information about a genetic condition.

concepts.label: HIV/AIDS
concepts.definition: Information about HIV or AIDS.

A minor (under 18 on the consent date, from ucm:birthDate) is their own grantor, but the directive is not governedByPolicy a ucm:SelfConsentRule in force in its jurisdiction whose minimum age the subject had reached.
sparql.select:
PREFIX ucm:  <https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#>
            PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
            PREFIX time: <http://www.w3.org/2006/time#>
            PREFIX xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
            PREFIX dpv:  <https://w3id.org/dpv#>
            SELECT $this ?subject WHERE {
                $this ucm:consentSubject/ucm:participatingEntity ?subject .
                $this ucm:recordsConsentFrom ?ci .
                ?gp ucm:assumesRole/a/rdfs:subClassOf* ucm:ConsentGrantorRole .
                { ?gp ucm:occursWithin ?ci } UNION { ?ci ucm:hasParticipant ?gp }
                ?gp ucm:participatingEntity ?subject .
                ?subject ucm:birthDate ?bd .
                ?ci ucm:occursDuring ?when .
                ?when (time:hasBeginning/(time:inXSDDateTimeStamp|time:inXSDDateTime))|time:inXSDDateTimeStamp|time:inXSDDateTime ?at .
                # Latest possible birth date for a partial date: the conservative reading.
                BIND (STR(?bd) AS ?b)
                BIND (IF(STRLEN(?b) = 4, CONCAT(?b, "-12-31"), IF(STRLEN(?b) = 7, CONCAT(?b, "-31"), SUBSTR(?b, 1, 10))) AS ?latest)
                BIND (SUBSTR(STR(?at), 1, 10) AS ?on)
                BIND (xsd:integer(SUBSTR(?on, 1, 4)) - xsd:integer(SUBSTR(?latest, 1, 4))
                      - IF(SUBSTR(?on, 6, 5) < SUBSTR(?latest, 6, 5), 1, 0) AS ?age)
                FILTER (?age < 18)
                FILTER NOT EXISTS {
                    $this ucm:governedByPolicy ?rule .
                    ?rule a/rdfs:subClassOf* ucm:SelfConsentRule ;
                          dpv:hasJurisdiction ?rj .
                    { $this dpv:hasJurisdiction/ucm:withinJurisdiction* ?rj }
                    UNION
                    { ?ci dpv:hasJurisdiction/ucm:withinJurisdiction* ?rj }
                    OPTIONAL { ?rule ucm:minimumSelfConsentAge ?min }
                    FILTER (!BOUND(?min) || ?age >= ?min)
                }
            }
